---
name: changelog
description: Add an entry to CHANGELOG.md under Unreleased. Use when the user asks to record a change in the changelog.
---

# Changelog

Add the entry under `## [Unreleased]`, in the section that fits: Added, Changed, Fixed or Removed.
Write it for the people who use the project, not for the people who wrote it.
See https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.1.0/ for the format.
